title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda to Amazon S3
description: Create an API Gateway API that fetches a presigned URL from S3 via Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern helps you to deploy a CDK stack with API Gateway, Lambda, and S3 bucket. For an HTTP GET request with the query string of an object key to the APIGateway Endpoint backed by AWS Lambda Function will generate the PresignedURL for the object available in the S3 Bucket.
